site.name: Arrow 1, 2, 3
site.location: Boulder County Tungsten Mining District, north and northwest of the Western Star shaft
overview: Arrow 1, 2, 3 was a small tungsten property in Boulder County's tungsten-mining district, developed by a group of shallow shafts north and northwest of the Western Star shaft.
Colorado's 1960 tungsten inventory records the property as a minor producer owned by Cold Spring Tungsten, Inc.

timeline.text: The Arrow 1, 2, 3 property was developed by shallow shafts in the Boulder County tungsten district.
Colorado's statewide tungsten inventory reported production of less than 500 units, listed Cold Spring Tungsten, Inc. as owner, and named T. J. Henning as the last operator.

moreHistory: The 1960 Colorado tungsten inventory places Arrow 1, 2, 3 in the northeast quarter of Section 7, Township 1 South, Range 72 West, north and northwest of the Western Star shaft.
Published records describe the workings simply as shallow shafts and do not identify a documented ore occurrence or known development potential for the property.

The mapped locality near 39.97889, -105.49167 is used as a grouped site-level reference for Arrow 1, 2, 3. Several historic workings in this dense mining area share generalized locality points, so the coordinate should not be interpreted as a surveyed surviving shaft collar, property boundary, or statement of present-day access.
